$comment: Golden Q&A set. `expected` = citation labels (document › section) that contain the answer; a retrieved chunk counts as a hit if its label equals or starts with one of them. `facts` must appear in a correct answer. `forbidden` = a document this user must never retrieve (row-level security). Empty `expected` = the answer is not in the documents, so the model must refuse.
